# Reference generation prompts

Generated with the built-in imagegen tool, one image per theme.

## Light

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a single large readable desktop screenshot reference for Mailloop Compose, LIGHT THEME, 1440x1100 proportions. Vercel inspired white and #fafafa surfaces, near black system sans typography, subtle gray 1px borders, 6px corners, no decorative illustrations, minimal shadows. Sparse Inngest coral #e45c48 accents on monospace section labels only. Header: Mailloop left, Gmail connected green dot, theme toggle and avatar right. Horizontal navigation Compose (active black underline), Contacts, Templates, History, Usage, Settings. Main width 1200px, compact left heading Compose, subtitle Personalized outreach, one recipient at a time. Search recipients field below. Two columns 3:2: left flat bordered message section labelled 01 / THE MESSAGE containing template select, role select and helper; below 02 / YOUR SHORTLIST with select controls and two individual recipient rows Ada Chen / Northstar / [REDACTED_EMAIL] and Sam Patel / Orbit / [REDACTED_EMAIL], neutral checked checkboxes. Right personal preview with recipient select, message to Ada and subject and email body with muted coral personalization highlights; attachment row; below send queue with capacity bar and bold BLACK Send 2 emails button. Keep the real tool interface practical, compact and readable, generous but not wasteful spacing. Blue links/focus, green meaningful status. No purple, gradients, floating decorations, extra invented controls.

## Dark

Use case: ui-mockup. Single large readable desktop screenshot reference of Mailloop Compose DARK THEME, 1440x1100 proportions. Vercel inspired near-black #0a0a0a page, #111 panels, #303030 1px borders, offwhite system sans typography, 6px corners, minimal shadows. Inngest coral sparingly on monospace section labels. Header Mailloop, Gmail connected green dot, theme toggle, avatar. Underline horizontal nav Compose, Templates, Contacts, Usage, History, Settings. Main width 1200px compact Compose heading subtitle Personalized outreach, one recipient at a time. Search recipients input. Two columns 3:2. Left 01 / THE MESSAGE with template dropdown and role dropdown. Below 02 / YOUR SHORTLIST with selection controls and individual Ada Chen / Northstar and Sam Patel / Orbit rows with neutral checkboxes and email details. Right 03 / PERSONAL PREVIEW with recipient dropdown, subject and body of personalized email with subtle coral marks, attachment row. Below send queue with selected count capacity bar and solid white Send 2 emails button black type. Real usable tool, readable not tiny, compact spacious typography. Green amber red only meaningful status, blue links. No purple no gradients no decorative illustration, no mock browser frame.
